StageAttention[1]: Baptized by the disciple and blessed with Cradle's gift, the Pterygota Queen metamorphoses into a new form—regression, mutation, fission, symbiosis, eclosion... a rebirth through polarization. She is the new blade chosen by the Red Tide, born to bring an end to human civilization.
StageAttention[2]: The Polarized Pterygota Queen leaps toward her prey, delivering a downward slash with her Execution Legs.
StageAttention[3]: With her Fluted Spines aiding her acceleration, the Polarized Pterygota Queen dashes toward her prey and delivers a sweeping slash with her Execution Legs.
StageAttention[4]: The Polarized Pterygota Queen evolves her Execution Legs, unleashing a flurry of slashes against her prey.
StageAttention[5]: The player character and the Boss each have their own Saturation Gauge. The character can consume the Saturation Gauge to perform a Threshold Dodge, empowering their next attack. The Boss can consume the Saturation Gauge to unleash Overdrive Moves. During Overdrive, the Boss is immune to all damage, and the final hit of the move is enhanced. The character cannot avoid Overdrive Moves with a normal dodge. When either side's Saturation Gauge is depleted, that combatant enters Attrition, interrupting their current skill and inflicting Stun. While in Attrition, the affected combatant cannot use their Saturation Gauge until it has fully recovered.
StageAttention[6]: Enhanced dodge. While in the Threshold State, the character is immune to all damage from enemies, including damage from Overdrive Moves. Performing a Threshold Surge empowers the character's next attack. If the character is launched, knocked down, or in hitstun, Threshold Surge quickly restores their combat stance.
StageAttention[7]: An empowered state gained after performing Threshold Surge. While in this state, the character's next attack—either a Basic Attack or an Orb Ping—is enhanced as follows: Threshold Resonance (Basic Attack): The character is healed, recovers Saturation Gauge and a small amount of Signature Energy, and can perform Threshold Anticipation against the enemy's Green Overdrive Moves. Threshold Resonance (Orb Ping): The character recovers Signature Energy and can perform Threshold Anticipation against the enemy's Red Overdrive Moves.
StageAttention[8]: When the character uses Threshold Surge to dodge the Boss's Overdrive Move, the Threshold Reversal Window opens. During this window, an opening appears in the Boss's next Overdrive Move. Based on the color of the opening, the character must choose either Threshold Resonance (Basic Attack) or Threshold Resonance (Orb Ping) to perform Threshold Reversal and counter-break the Boss's Overdrive Move. If successful, the Boss's Overdrive Move is counter-broken, and the character recovers a large amount of Saturation Gauge and Signature Energy. If the counter-break fails, both the character's and the Boss's attacks are interrupted, and the character recovers a small amount of Signature Energy. If the Threshold Reversal Window is missed, the Boss will continue unleashing subsequent Overdrive Moves.
StageAttention[9]: Hold [Threshold Surge] to expend all Threshold Surge energy and unleash a short-range burst capable of parrying the Boss's Overdrive Moves. When the character parries one of the Boss's Overdrive Moves during Threshold Parry, the character takes no damage from that attack, recovers a large amount of Saturation Gauge, and counter-breaks the move. If no Overdrive Move is successfully parried, the character's Saturation Gauge is fully depleted when the burst ends, and the character enters Attrition.
StageAttention[10]: An enhanced move with a red/green weak point. During Overdrive, the Boss is immune to all damage. If the player character dodges the final hit of an Overdrive Move, a set amount of Threshold Surge Gauge is consumed.
